name: biopods-backend
description: Bio-inspired immune system for Kubernetes - Backend Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @biopods/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @biopods/visualization-hub" "npm run dev -w @biopods/telemetry-ingest" "npm run dev -w @biopods/self-heal" "npm run dev -w @biopods/ollama-service"
scripts.demo: concurrently "tsx gateway.ts" "tsx services/api-gateway/index.ts" "tsx services/visualization-hub/index.ts" "tsx services/telemetry-ingest/index.ts" "tsx services/self-heal/index.ts" "set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8&& ..\.venv\Scripts\python services/agent-python/patrol_agent.py" "set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8&& ..\.venv\Scripts\python services/agent-dendritic/main.py"
